title: Form stays open after a new giveaway is paid, so Start can be paid a second time
trigger: Open a channel's boosts page > Get Boosts via Gifts > pick a Premium/Stars option > Start Giveaway > pay in the checkout > close the paid screen.
effect: The Giveaway dialog (is_open = form.is_some() && !payment_dialog_visible) comes back with the same draft and an enabled Start Giveaway; nothing sets launch=Launched or takes the form after a payment (pay_new_giveaway only sets a note). The user can open the checkout again and buy a second giveaway.
fix: Make the form an enum (Editing, AwaitingPayment{invoice}, Paid, Launching, Launched) and move it to Paid/close it when the checkout's paid answer for that invoice arrives.

title: Cancel / Esc on the transfer confirmation while the transfer is in flight loses the success handling
trigger: Pick a contact > Transfer (a paid transfer) > press Cancel or Esc before the answer lands.
effect: TransferPicker::back() only refuses while export_busy(), not while TransferGift is out, so the stage goes ConfirmPeer -> Pick. apply_gift_manage_ok then finds no ConfirmPeer stage, leaves manage.transferred None and clears the flow: no 'Gift transferred' toast, the recipient's chat is not opened, and the user is shown the list as if nothing happened.
fix: Add a TransferStage::Transferring{user_id,name} variant entered by confirm_picked_transfer; back/Esc are refused there and the answer matches it.

title: A pending 'learn more' value lookup opens its box after the user left the gift
trigger: Open a collectible's gift box or the resale buy box > tap 'learn more' on the Value row > close the box (or switch to another gift/box) before the answer lands.
effect: hub.gift_value is owned by nobody: no close path clears it, GiftValueLookup::land sets open=true for the matching request, and the GiftValue dialog is_open only reads lookup.open. The value box pops up later over whatever is on screen. A failed lookup's error also stays on the row until another click.
fix: Scope the lookup to its host box (gift id) and drop it when that box closes or the gift changes; make loading/ready/failed one Fetch-like enum.

title: Reopening the form resets a launch that is still in flight, so Start can be sent twice
trigger: Prepaid giveaway > Start Giveaway > confirm (launch Launching) > close the dialog > open the same prepaid giveaway again before the answer.
effect: open_giveaway_form sets launch=Idle unconditionally, so launching() no longer matches the old request; the Start button is enabled and a second launchPrepaidGiveaway goes out. The server rejects it and the form shows 'Couldn't start the giveaway' although the first one launched.
fix: Keep Launching{chat,request} across form reopen for the same prepaid id (form opens in a Launching state) instead of resetting it.

title: pending_auction opens the auction box after the user closed the send box
trigger: Send-gift box > tap an auction tile (fetch_gift_auction sent, pending_auction=true) > close the send box before the state arrives.
effect: pending_auction is cleared only when the stack empties or the answer lands; it is not tied to the box that asked. When auction_ready arrives the bid/info box opens over nothing, with a recipient captured from the closed send box.
fix: Replace pending_auction with an enum on the market UI (Idle, Opening{auction_id, request}) cancelled when the asking box closes and matched to the answer's request.

title: market_replace skips after_market_pop so bid slider/custom field and hide_name outlive the replaced box
trigger: Auction bid box > 'Send a gift' (market_replace to AuctionSend) > back out and open another auction's bid box.
effect: The popped AuctionBid never reaches the arm that clears slider/custom, and hide_name is only cleared when the stack empties, so the old chosen amount / custom field / Hide My Name can show in the next box.
fix: Carry slider/custom/hide_name inside the MarketBox variants that own them so popping or replacing drops them.

title: Message typed in the send-gift list is carried into the resale buy 'Send' step
trigger: Send-gift box list view: type in the Premium gift message textarea > tap a sold-out gift's resale tile > pick a listing > Buy.
effect: pick_resale_listing resets gift_hide_name but not payments.gift_message_input, and the buy step shows and sends the same input, so the unrelated text is prefilled for the recipient.
fix: Reset the three send inputs in one place (a SendGiftInputs value created per box/step) instead of per call site.

title: gift_premium_by_stars is not reset when the send-gift box opens
trigger: Send-gift box for a friend > tick 'Pay with Stars instead' > close > open the box for another person.
effect: reset_send_gift_inputs clears the message, hide_name and pay_upgrade but not gift_premium_by_stars, so the Stars payment choice persists across recipients and opens.
fix: Put message, hide_name, pay_upgrade and by_stars in one SendGiftInputs struct replaced whole when the box opens.

title: Countries page shows 'Loading countries' forever when the list fails to load
trigger: Giveaway form > Choose countries while getCountries fails or the send fails (error ignored with let _).
effect: session.auth_state.countries stays None; the page has no error or retry arm, so it shows the loading text until the form is closed.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<Country>> for the list so the failed arm shows the error and a Retry.

title: Giveaway options of the previous chat are shown for a new chat while loading
trigger: Open the giveaway form for channel A (options load) > close > open it for channel B.
effect: request_giveaway_options sets *_loading but keeps options.premium/stars from A, and the body only shows 'Loading prices' when both lists are empty, so A's prices are shown and selectable until B's answer.
fix: Key the options by boosted chat (Fetch<Options> inside the form) and clear on open.

title: SendGift box never names its window with open_box
trigger: Open the send-gift box from a chat window's header menu while the last press was in another window.
effect: SendGift is a session-wide dialog whose flag is set by the driver (send.open) and no site calls open_box(DialogKind::SendGift), so the box shows in the window of the last press, not the window that asked.
fix: Call open_box(DialogKind::SendGift) in open_send_gift_in / open_send_gift_to_user next to the driver call.

title: requested_files is stored even when the downloads were not sent
trigger: Open a resale or auction box while the client is not connected or download_file returns Err.
effect: download_file/follow_gift_auction results are dropped with let _ and requested_files is updated whenever the set changes, so the failed set is never retried until the set changes; follow_gift_auction sets followed before a failed send.
fix: Record a file as requested only when its download request was sent; make following an enum with the request outcome.

title: drain_gift_market_notes shows only the last of several notes
trigger: Two market answers fail in one frame (for example a failed purchase and a failed craft).
effect: notes are taken as a Vec and only notes.into_iter().last() is shown; earlier ones are lost.
fix: Queue notes through the toast queue one by one.

title: Reopening the gifts dialog resets gift_mutating while a mutation is in flight
trigger: Gifts dialog > confirm Upgrade (or Transfer/Pin) > close the dialog and reopen My Gifts before the answer.
effect: open_received_gifts sets hub.gift_mutating=false, which the UI uses to enable Upgrade/Transfer/Resale/Delete buttons (gift_owner_actions.rs busy), so a second request can be sent for the same gift; the first answer then clears the flag for the new list.
fix: Make the mutation an enum (Idle, Mutating{request, gift}) owned by the session and not reset by open; match answers by request id.

title: Delete Gift confirmation is a kit alert not tied to the account or the gift list it was asked for
trigger: Gifts dialog > Delete Gift (alert opens) > switch account from the Dock/tray with the alert up, then press Delete.
effect: The on_ok closure calls confirm_delete_gift(id) on whatever live client is current and driver.delete_received_gift does not check the id is in the open list, so a stale id is sent for the other account (the server rejects it, the user sees an error for an action they never asked).
fix: Carry an OwnedBy<account,gift> in the closure and ignore the OK when the owner is not current.

title: One-shot slots manage.export_url / transferred / deleted are drained by a per-frame upkeep
trigger: Not a bug today: Fragment URL, transferred toast and deleted toast are Option/bool slots taken by gift_transfer_frame_upkeep in the window that hosts GiftTransfer (or the last press).
effect: A slot not taken (hosting window gone, locked, hidden) stays set and fires later; any new producer needs the same drain by hand.
fix: Push these as events into a queue owned by the asking window (Asker) instead of slots on the session.

title: pending_auction bool kept in step with session auction_loading and auction_ready
trigger: Tile or link asks for an auction: pending_auction=true, driver sets auction_loading, reducer sets auction_ready; the frame upkeep ends pending when either changes.
effect: Three fields carry one stage (idle, loading, ready, failed).
fix: enum AuctionOpen { Idle, Loading{request}, Ready{gift_id} }.

title: forge_started Option<Instant> and craft_primary Option next to the Craft stack boxes
trigger: Craft flow: craft_primary is set for CraftInfo, forge_started marks the forge, the box shown comes from stack and session craft.
effect: The craft stage is spread over stack top, session.craft and two UI Options.
fix: One CraftStage enum (Info, Select, Forging{since}, Result) in the box variant.

title: Bid slider and custom field Options live beside the AuctionBid box in the stack
trigger: slider and custom are Some only while an AuctionBid is on the stack, cleared by after_market_pop.
effect: Two Options must follow one stack entry by hand (see the market_replace bug).
fix: Move them into MarketBox::AuctionBid{gift_id, bid: BidUi}.

title: GiveawayForm.confirming bool beside page enum and the session's launch state
trigger: Form, 'are you sure', pick pages, launching and launched are chosen in giveaway_form_body by checking launch, confirming, page in that order.
effect: Five stages across three fields in two owners.
fix: enum FormStage { Editing(Page), Confirming, Launching, Launched, Failed } on the form.

title: GiveawayInfoLookup has loading, error and info Option kept in step
trigger: getGiveawayInfo: loading=true, then info Some or error Some.
effect: Three fields for four stages; matched to its request by take_answer.
fix: Fetch<GiveawayInfoData>.

title: GiveawayOptions premium_loading/stars_loading/premium_error/stars_error beside the lists
trigger: Two requests fill two lists; the body derives loading from loading() && both empty.
effect: Each list is a loading bool, an error Option and a Vec.
fix: Two Fetch<Vec<Option>> values.

title: GiftValueLookup loading/error/info/open
trigger: The lookup is loading, ready (info+open), failed (error) or closed (info, open=false).
effect: Four fields, request id and name filter.
fix: Fetch<GiftValueInfo> plus an open flag owned by the dialog.

title: SendGiftState gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/sending/done/error stage flags
trigger: List loading, loaded, sending, sent ('done') and failed ('error') are separate fields read in build_send_gift_dialog.
effect: Both done and error can be set; sending beside them.
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableGift>> for the list and enum SendStage { Idle, Sending{request}, Sent, Failed }.

title: ResaleSearch loading/loaded/error flags
trigger: The resale box reads search.loaded, search.loading and search.error together to pick empty text, spinner or Show more.
effect: Three fields for one fetch stage per page.
fix: Fetch<Page> per search generation.

title: hub.gift_mutating bool gates every owner action button
trigger: Set by the driver before a pin/upgrade/transfer/resale/delete request and cleared by the reducer.
effect: A bare bool with no request id (see the reopen bug).
fix: enum GiftMutation { Idle, Running{request, purpose} }.

title: ResaleBuy step + sending + price_changed + pay_in_grams
trigger: Buy view/send/confirm steps, a sending bool and a price_changed Option are changed by set_buy_step/set_buy_grams and the reducer.
effect: sending is a stage flag next to step; price_changed is cleared by hand in set_buy_grams.
fix: BuyStep with Sending{request} and PriceChanged{new} variants.

title: AwardMembers loading/error/user_ids beside generation and asked-guard
trigger: The members page shows error, loading row, empty text or list from list.error, list.loading and shown.
effect: Both error and loading can be set; paging guarded by a second Asked struct in PaymentsUi.
fix: Fetch<Page> with the paging position inside.

title: Stream Key stays revealed after the Settings box is left by Share or Leave, so the next Settings shows it without the warning
trigger: Manager opens the live stream window, Settings, Show key and accepts the warning (key_shown = true), then taps Share (line 294 sets overlay = None directly) or confirms Leave (line 491). Later reopens Settings in the same call.
effect: The RTMP stream key is drawn in clear without going through the KeyWarning box again; only close_stream_overlay and StreamWindow::clear reset key_shown.
fix: Make the key reveal part of the overlay enum (StreamOverlay::Settings { key_shown }) so every path that drops the overlay drops the reveal, instead of two fields reset by hand in two of the exits.

title: Stream overlay and key reveal are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Any open/close of the stream window boxes.
effect: See P2-001; also the overlay is only cleared by StreamWindow::clear, not by sync_group_call_boxes, so it outlives a changed call while a live PiP keeps the stream.
fix: One enum for the stream window box (none, settings with key hidden/shown, speakers, leave, revoke, warning) owned by the screen, dropped with the call in sync_group_call_boxes.

title: Group call window stage is window: Option plus window_opening: bool plus window_visible: bool
trigger: Open/close/replace the video chat window (open_group_call_window defers the open; sync_group_call_window removes and reopens when the layout changes).
effect: No bug found today: window_opening is cleared in the deferred open on both arms. The stages closed/opening/open(visible|hidden) are three fields.
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening { stream: bool }, Open { handle, visible, is_stream } }.

title: Stream join is three fields: stream_join intent, stream_joining id and stream_join_timeout task
trigger: Watch a stream or create a video chat; join_stream sets stream_joining and the timeout, settle_stream_join / stream_join_ended / stream_join_failed / sync_group_call_window clear the pair in five places.
effect: No stuck state found: every exit clears both fields, and the task is dropped with the Option. But stream_joining and stream_join_timeout must always be Some/None together.
fix: enum StreamJoin { Idle, Wanted { intent, tracked_then }, Joining { call: i32, timeout: Task<()> } } with one method that leaves Joining.

title: A stream join wish for a call that never gets tracked lingers and can join much later
trigger: Tap a stream link or the chat's video chat button (note_stream_join_intent records Call(id) with tracked_then = None); the call is never tracked (request fails or the user waits). Later, with no other call tracked, the same call is tracked from another entry (e.g. a link to the same call).
effect: consume_stream_join_intent finds the matching intent and joins immediately although the user only meant to look; the wish has no timeout or cancel except close_group_call_window and a different call being tracked.
fix: Give the Wanted stage a deadline (manual clock) or clear it when the request that fetches the call fails.

title: StreamWindow holds several staged fields: hide_armed + hide_task, photo (None while blurring) + photo_task, title_pressed
trigger: Hover/move in full screen (arm_stream_hide_timer), first frame of a stream with a chat photo (group_call_stream_photo).
effect: No bug found: hide_armed is cleared when the loop ends; photo/photo_task are replaced together. A blur that fails leaves (path, None) for good, with no retry (cosmetic).
fix: hide timer as Option<Task> alone (armed iff Some, cleared by the task's last step); photo as Fetch<Arc<RenderImage>> keyed by path.

title: Blurred stream photo is kept after the chat loses its photo
trigger: During a live stream the channel photo is removed (chat_photo_path returns None).
effect: group_call_stream_photo returns at the first ? without clearing StreamWindow::photo, so the picture view keeps the old chat's blurred photo behind the label until the call ends.
fix: When the chat has no photo path, drop the cached photo (and its task) in the same place.

title: Global push-to-talk hook is a controller plus a listener-stop flag plus a polling bool kept in step by sync_global_ptt
trigger: Join a group call with push-to-talk on, switch it off, lose Input Monitoring permission.
effect: No bug found: the stop flag is set whenever the hook is replaced or inactive, global_ptt_polling is cleared by its own task. The three must change together.
fix: enum GlobalPtt { Off, Running { hook, stop }, NeedsPermission { poll: Task<()> } } with the key-capture arming as its own variant of a shortcut-capture enum.

title: Share Invite Link asks for the links and opens the box under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock Quill with a joined video chat (call windows stay usable), press Share in the call window menu or the invite row.
effect: group_call_needs_unlock only raises the main window and its result is ignored: the links request is sent and share_open is set while locked; the box appears at the unlock without being asked again. Other call-window openers refuse with refused_while_locked.
fix: Check refused_while_locked (or queue an unlock intent) in open_group_call_share_links before the request, and return when group_call_needs_unlock is true.

title: Share and invite boxes are bools plus a call id in step
trigger: Open Share Invite Link, then the call changes or the links fail.
effect: No bug found: sync_group_call_boxes closes them when boxes_call changes and when the links are neither generating nor ready. share_open, share_speaker and share_copied are one box's stage.
fix: enum VideoChatBox { None, Invite, Share { speaker, copied } } with the call id inside it.

title: Sharing a call link to a chat overwrites a pending deep-link open
trigger: A deep link is waiting in links.pending_deep_link_open (for example queued while an earlier open is in progress), then the user picks a chat under Share to.
effect: The single Option slot is replaced; the earlier link action is lost without a note.
fix: Queue opens (Vec/VecDeque of PendingOpen) or refuse the share while one is pending.

title: In-call chat visibility and per-participant level animations outlive the call
trigger: Open the in-call chat (Show chat) in a video chat, leave, join another video chat. For levels: a participant sounds then leaves.
effect: chat_shown is never reset (only toggled and initialised), so the next call's window opens with the chat section already shown. row_levels entries are removed only when that row is built again, so a leaver's entry stays for the process and an audio_source_id reused by a later call starts from a stale animation.
fix: Move per-call UI into one CallView value created when a call is tracked and dropped when it ends (sync_group_call_boxes already knows the call id).

title: StageVolume keeps sender, level and a dragging bool beside the slider; dragging is cleared only by a Release event
trigger: Drag the stage volume slider and let the pointer-up land outside the slider/window so no Release event arrives.
effect: dragging stays true, so the slider is never remade when the server level changes, and the entry (app-wide GroupCallUi) also survives call end and account switch until another sender is pinned.
fix: enum StageVolume { Idle { level }, Dragging } owned by the screen's pin, dropped with the call.

title: A failed fetch for the Invite Links, Join Requests or Administrators page shows the loading spinner for good
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite Links (or Join Requests / Administrators) when the driver cannot send the request (Err is dropped by `let _ = match view`).
effect: The session never gets a Loading/Failed entry, and the sections draw None the same as Loading (spinner). Only the small refresh icon recovers; no error and no Retry button.
fix: Treat an Err from the fetch as Fetch::Failed in the session, and draw None as 'not asked' (ask again) rather than as Loading.

title: Upgrade to supergroup confirm closes the box before the request is answered
trigger: Group Settings > Upgrade > confirm while the driver refuses the request (Err) or returns None.
effect: group_settings_action runs, then close_group_settings_dialog runs regardless; a failure only produces a toast and the user must reopen the box to try again.
fix: Make the upgrade a request stage (Confirm, Sending, Failed(reason)) that closes on the answer or on the pump_chat_upgrades event.

title: A chat window showing a group that was upgraded stays on the dead group when the main window handle is gone
trigger: Open a basic group in a chat window, close or hide the main window so main_window.handle is None, then upgrade the group (from another device or the chat window's box).
effect: move_upgraded_chat_window returns early; the chat window keeps the deactivated basic group, the upgrade event has already been taken by take_chat_upgrades.
fix: Open the replacement window from any live window handle, or retarget the chat window's chat in place.

title: Per-window glyph sweep is pending: Option, sweep_when_idle: bool, kept/seen counters in step
trigger: Idle trim begins a sweep (begin), the next render finishes it (start_frame), a window goes to the background (window_activation).
effect: No user-visible bug found. A pending sweep waits for a render of that window; a window that is hidden and never renders keeps pending (no new sweep for it) until it closes (forget_closed_windows) or draws.
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Marked(PendingSweep) } plus an idle-trigger enum; or clear Marked when the window reports it is hidden.

title: Giveaway form carries confirming: bool and page enum for what is one wizard stage
trigger: Open Boosts via Gifts, pick Users/Countries pages, tap launch on a prepaid giveaway.
effect: No bug found here (Farewell closes the form on account switch). `confirming` and `page` can both be set; whether the confirm step shows over a list page depends on the renderer.
fix: enum GiveawayStep { Form, Users, Countries, ConfirmPrepaid } (note lives with the step).

title: A failed call window open re-notes the error on every sync
trigger: Join a voice chat on a platform/state where cx.open_window returns Err; sync_call_windows runs every frame/poll, window stays None while the call is wanted, so open_group_call_window runs again
effect: The 'could not open the video chat' note is raised again and again, and an open attempt is made on every sync
fix: Make the window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call id)) so a failed open for a call is remembered and not retried until the call changes.

title: Call window lifecycle as window + window_opening + window_visible + stream.window_is_stream
trigger: Open, hide, close and re-layout the voice chat window
effect: window_visible keeps its last value after the window closes, window_is_stream is only meaningful with Some(window); four fields kept in step by hand
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening{stream}, Open{handle, stream, visible} }.

title: Stream join as stream_join + stream_joining + stream_join_timeout
trigger: Press Watch/Join on a live stream
effect: Three Options that must be set and cleared together (timeout task is dropped in six places by hand)
fix: enum StreamJoin { Idle, Wanted{intent, tracked_then}, Joining{call, timeout: Task} }.

title: A join intent noted before fetch_group_call is not cleared when the fetch fails
trigger: Press the voice chat button, fetch_group_call returns Err (note says could not reach); later join that same call another way
effect: stream_join stays set until a call is tracked, then the window auto-joins the stream the user gave up on
fix: Note the intent only after the send succeeded, or clear it in the Err arm.

title: Rename box is closed before the rename is sent, so a failed send loses the typed title
trigger: Open Rename voice chat, type a title, Save while set_video_chat_title returns Err or there is no live client
effect: Box closes with an error note; the typed title is gone and must be retyped
fix: Take the dialog out only on Ok; put it back on Err (as restrict/permissions boxes do).

title: In-call composer text survives a change of call within the account
trigger: Type a message in call A's chat, leave A, join call B in the same account; the unsent text is still in the box and Send posts it to B
effect: A draft written for one call is sent to another; sync_group_call_boxes resets the rename box, invite, share and pin but not the composer
fix: Clear the composer in the same branch of sync_group_call_boxes that resets other per-call state (before != id).

title: Edit box closes as saved when a second Save fails to send
trigger: Save the group (title refused, box shows Failed), fix nothing and press Save again while save_group_type/save_group_info returns Err (InvalidRequest, no rights, send error)
effect: The first lines of save_group_type clear info_edit_errors; the Err arm keeps the old saving ids, which are answered; state() is now requests gone and no error = Saved, so group_edit_box() reports the box closed (shell closes it) with only an error toast and the edits lost
fix: Make saving an enum field Editing/Saving(ids)/Failed(reason); Err sets Failed in the box itself instead of leaving the old ids to be re-derived.

title: Edit box state ignores failures that record no error: photo upload, username premium limit, unknown username problems, type edits
trigger: Edit a group, pick a new photo (or a link that needs Premium) and Save; TDLib refuses the photo or link
effect: record_group_info_edit_error returns without storing for those purposes and state() excludes GroupInfoField::Photo, so the box counts as Saved and closes; nothing anywhere shows the photo error
fix: Track each sent request's result in the box (per-request outcome enum) rather than inferring success from the absence of an error entry.

title: A box derived as Saved is never removed and can reopen as Failed
trigger: Save succeeds (box closes); later another Manage action (upgrade, sign/translate toggle) records a Settings error for the same chat in info_edit_errors
effect: admin.group_edit_box still holds the old box with saving=Some(done ids); state() flips Saved -> Failed, group_edit_box() returns it again and the host reopens the Edit box with a stale reason
fix: Drop admin.group_edit_box (via close_group_edit_box) when the state becomes Saved, not just hide it.

title: Partial send on Save error leaves some edits applied but untracked
trigger: Save a title change plus a photo where the first request is sent and the next send returns Err
effect: save_group_info stops at the failed edit; what was sent stays sent but the box does not track those ids (saving not set on Err), so no Failed/Saving state shows for them and a retry resends
fix: Return the ids sent so far with the error and keep them in saving.

title: Edit box stage is saving + title_empty + title_emoji + type_box + history_box + photo/photo_note
trigger: Edit, Save, open sub boxes, emoji panel
effect: Stage is derived partly from the session (requests, errors) and partly from five fields in the box and the shared media panel; Saved is a derived state that is never applied
fix: enum EditBoxStage owned by the box: Editing{sub: None|Type|History|Emoji}, Saving(ids), Failed{field,reason}.

title: Title emoji panel is edit.title_emoji AND pickers.media_panel open, kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the name field emoji panel, close the panel with Esc/outside click, or let the box turn Saved
effect: title_emoji stays true after the shared panel closes; close_group_title_emoji only closes the panel when group_edit_box() is Some, so a box that became Saved while the panel was open leaves the panel open
fix: The panel's open state carries its owner (MediaPanelOwner::GroupTitle) in one value.

title: Sticker pack loading derived from request purposes plus stickers.failed flags
trigger: Press Load packs in the Edit box
effect: busy/loading come from has_purpose over two purposes and session.stickers.*.failed sits beside them; no stage enum
fix: Fetch<T> for each pack list.

title: Picked contacts are taken out of the Add members list before the send
trigger: Pick contacts in Add members and press Add while add_chat_members returns Err
effect: Selection is emptied (mem::take) and an error toast shows; user must pick everyone again
fix: Clear the selection only on Ok(Some).

title: Unban/kick refetch the member page right after sending, before the change applies
trigger: Unban a member in the Banned tab (or remove one from Add exception)
effect: refresh_supergroup_members clears the cache and asks again immediately; the page can come back with the member still there and nothing refetches after the status change lands
fix: Refetch on the answer to the set-status request (match by request id).

title: Promote, edit-rights and demote treat Ok(None) (driver refused) as success
trigger: Demote the owner or press Demote twice quickly (duplicate in flight); promote without the right
effect: submit_admin_dialog matches Ok(_): the dialog is dropped and the note says 'Admin demoted' / 'Member promoted' though nothing was sent (Restrict handles Ok(None) correctly)
fix: Match Ok(Some(_)) as success and keep the dialog with an error on Ok(None), as submit_restrict_dialog does.

title: Restrict, ban, promote and demote dialogs close on send, so a server refusal is not shown in the box
trigger: Ban or restrict a member who cannot be restricted (admin, rights changed); TDLib answers with an error
effect: Box has already closed with 'Member banned' note; failure surfaces only in member_action_error of the member dialog if it happens to be open
fix: Hold the dialog in a Sending(request id) stage and close it on the matching answer.

title: Permissions Save closes silently when nothing was sent
trigger: Change a permission and Save when set_chat_permissions refuses (no right, same request in flight)
effect: save_permissions_box returns Ok(false) for 'nothing differs or the viewer may not save'; the box closes with no note, the change is lost
fix: Distinguish Unchanged from Refused in the return type and keep the box with an error on Refused.

title: Permissions Save sends the permissions then fails on slow mode and restores the box
trigger: Change permissions and slow mode, Save when set_chat_slow_mode_delay returns Err
effect: Permissions were already sent but the box is restored and an error toast says it failed; Save again compares against the new state
fix: Report which parts were sent and close/restore per part.

title: Boost list is loading + error + boosts + next_offset
trigger: Open Boosts, switch All/Gifts tab, press Show more
effect: Page stage read from state.loading, state.error and next_offset together (error and loading can both be set); tab is state.only_gifts set by the request, not by the page
fix: Fetch<Page> with a tab key (BoostTab) carried by the request and checked on the answer.

title: Push-to-talk hook as ptt_capture + global_ptt_polling + global_ptt_listener_stop + global_ptt
trigger: Join a call with push-to-talk, rebind the key, leave
effect: Two bools and an Option kept in step with the controller; bound by hand in sync_global_ptt
fix: enum PttHook { Off, Capturing, Listening{stop} }.

title: Manage Topics dialog Delete button deletes a topic and all its messages with no confirmation
trigger: Open a forum's Manage Topics dialog (admin), click Delete on any non-General topic row.
effect: deleteForumTopic is sent at once and the topic with every message in it is gone; the context-menu path asks GroupConfirm::DeleteForumTopic first, this one does not. The note says 'Topic updated'.
fix: Route ForumTopicAction::Delete through open_group_confirm(DeleteForumTopic) like the topic menu; keep forum_topic_action for the non-destructive actions.

title: Topic editor closes as saved when the create/edit request failed
trigger: In the topic editor type a name, press Create/Save while the send fails (driver Err, or no live client).
effect: editor is set to None after the error note, so the typed name and chosen icon are lost and the list shows again as if saved.
fix: Clear the editor only in the Ok arm (or hold it as an enum Editing/Saving/Failed); keep it on Err.

title: Dialog builder asks for topic icon downloads on every build while the editor is open
trigger: Open the topic editor and leave it open.
effect: download_forum_topic_icons runs inside the dialog builder, a render-time side effect; each rebuild re-requests downloads for every icon file.
fix: Request the downloads once in begin_topic_editor (or when the icon list lands), not in the builder.

title: Topic info toggle is a bare bool on ChatUi
trigger: Click the topic info button in the topic strip.
effect: chat_ui.topic_info_open is flipped by hand and is not tied to the open topic; it stays set when the user selects another topic or leaves to the topic list.
fix: Make it part of an enum of the thread view (TopicList / Topic{id, info_open}) so leaving the topic drops it.

title: forum_chats_peek and forum_column_shown are two bools kept in step by the render path
trigger: Open a forum chat, press 'Chats' to peek, then resize the window or open a non-forum chat.
effect: forum_column_layout (called while rendering, takes &mut self) both resets forum_chats_peek and records forum_column_shown; derived state written every frame and the peek ends only when something renders.
fix: One enum ForumColumnState {Hidden, Column, Peek} in ChatUi, derived from the layout in one place, not written from render.

title: Selecting a topic flushes the draft and forgets scroll before the select can fail
trigger: Click a topic row while select_topic returns Err.
effect: The leaving draft is flushed and the target topic's scroll memory forgotten, then an error note shows and the old view stays; draft restore runs for a view that did not change.
fix: Do the flush/forget after select_topic returns Ok.

title: Welcome message text cleared even when the add failed
trigger: Type a welcome message, press Add while the request fails (driver Err or no live client).
effect: new_input is reset to empty after the error note, so the typed message is lost.
fix: Clear the input only in the Ok arm.

title: Welcome message edit closes as saved when the edit failed
trigger: Press Edit on a welcome message, change the text, press Save while the request fails.
effect: editing is set to None after the error note, the edit text is dropped and the row shows the old text as if saved.
fix: Leave editing set on Err; model the dialog row as Viewing/Editing{id}/Saving{id}.

title: Retry in the welcome dialog rebuilds the dialog and drops typed text
trigger: Type a new welcome message, load fails, press Retry.
effect: open_welcome_dialog replaces the whole WelcomeDialog (new inputs), so the typed text and an open edit are lost.
fix: Retry should only re-request load_chat_welcome_messages for the open dialog.

title: Welcome edit target is an Option<i32> not tied to the loaded list
trigger: Start editing a welcome message that is then deleted or replaced by an update.
effect: dialog.editing keeps pointing at an id that may be gone; Save sends editChatWelcomeMessage for a missing id and nothing on screen shows the edit.
fix: Drop editing when the id leaves welcome_messages, or hold the edited message's id and text in one enum variant.

title: Promote picker keeps a selection that the search results no longer show
trigger: Open Promote admin, tick member A, type another name and press Search so A is not in the new page, then press Promote.
effect: No radio is selected (selected_ix is None) but selected_user is still A and the Promote button stays enabled, so A is promoted to administrator with the rights shown, unseen.
fix: Clear selected_user in search_promote_members, and enable Promote only when selected_user is among the candidates shown (derive from the page, not stored).

title: Promote picker 'searched' is set when the search is sent, not when the page lands
trigger: Open Promote admin, type a query and press Search while offline or slow.
effect: The panel switches to the Search page key at once; it shows the previous Search page (cache key is chat+filter, not the query) or Loading, so rows of an older query appear under the new text. Not matched to the query that asked.
fix: Key the member page by (chat, filter, query) and set searched from the answer's query.

title: Stops slider thumb stays on a value the save refused
trigger: Drag the slow mode (or boosters) slider and release; the change request fails or the permission is refused and the caller's value does not change.
effect: on_change fires once on release; reported equals the caller's value so no resync happens, the thumb and the highlighted label stay on the unsaved stop while the real value is the old one.
fix: Resync the thumb whenever the caller's value differs from the slider's stop, not only when the caller's value changes; or make the pending drag an explicit variant.

title: reported, slider and release subscription are three keyed states kept in step by render
trigger: Render the slider; change the value from outside.
effect: reported mirrors the caller value, the slider holds the thumb, the subscription holds a clone of reported; correctness depends on the order of updates in render. Keyed by (kind, chat) only, so two windows of one chat share names but not state.
fix: One keyed state enum Synced(value) / Dragging(position).

title: save_refused flag and version counter drive the link status line
trigger: Press Save with an empty or bad link, then switch Public to Private and back.
effect: save_refused is a bool cleared only by a link edit; it stays set when the user flips Public/Private so the empty link shows 'too short' again without a new Save press. version is a keystroke token for the timer.
fix: Fold into one LinkCheck enum (Idle, Typed{version}, Refused{version}) cleared by choose_group_public too.

title: Choosing Public at the links limit leaves draft.public set while the box shows Private
trigger: Open Type box at the public links limit, click Public (limit box opens), dismiss it.
effect: draft.public is true but public_blocked hides it; if a link is freed later the box flips to Public with a link check the user did not choose. Save handles blocked correctly.
fix: Do not store the blocked choice; keep draft.public false until the limit clears.

title: Apply-to-invite-links alert answer is not matched to the type box that asked
trigger: Press Save in the Type box with join-approval changed, leave the alert open, close the Edit box (chat removed or window closed), open another group's Type box, then answer the alert.
effect: finish_group_type_box(Some(..)) applies to whatever type box is open now, not the chat that asked.
fix: Carry (chat_id, box token) in the alert and compare before finishing.

title: Username toggle error from an earlier try shows when the Type box is reopened
trigger: Toggle a username to active when at the limit (error shown), close the Type box, reopen it for the same chat.
effect: Session group_type.toggle_error is a single global slot, cleared only when a new toggle starts, so the old 'too many usernames' line appears on reopen.
fix: Clear the error in open_group_type_box and when the box closes, or keep it inside GroupTypeBox.

title: Show/hide username alert answer is not matched to the box that asked
trigger: Click a username, leave the alert open, close the Edit box and reopen it, answer the alert.
effect: toggle_group_type_username sends for the captured chat/name even if the box is no longer for that chat or the username list changed.
fix: Check that the Type box for chat_id is still open before sending.

title: Bulk 'delete chats' acts on the selection at submit time, not the one the user confirmed
trigger: Select chats, press Delete, and while the confirm box is open the list changes (a selected chat is archived or removed, another listed chat arrives and is re-listed in the selection).
effect: selected_chat_ids() is recomputed in submit_group_confirm; the confirm text names no chats and the enum is Copy, so the set deleted is whatever is selected then. Also the note reports success when 0 requests were sent.
fix: Carry the chat ids in the confirm variant (Vec) and show the count; report an error when none was sent.

title: Leave/Delete chat reports success and closes the Edit box when the request was only sent
trigger: Confirm Delete chat or Leave chat while TDLib then refuses (not allowed, flood).
effect: Note says 'Chat deleted' / 'Left the chat' and the Edit box is closed at dispatch; the failure (if surfaced) arrives later as a separate error and the box is gone.
fix: Show 'Deleting...' and close the Edit box from the chat's removal update, not from the send result.

title: Custom title / community name box closes as saved on dispatch
trigger: Edit an admin custom title and press Save; TDLib then rejects the change.
effect: Dialog is dropped when the request is sent and the note says 'Custom title updated'; the rejection arrives later and the typed title is lost.
fix: Hold the box as Editing/Saving{request}/Failed and close it on the answer.

title: UsernameDialog carries a community id in a ChatId field
trigger: Open Rename community.
effect: UsernameDialog.chat_id is ChatId(community_id) with the real id also inside TextPromptKind::CommunityName; the kinds of id share one field and one dialog slot for two unrelated prompts.
fix: Put the owner inside TextPromptKind (CustomTitle{chat,user} / CommunityName{community}) and drop chat_id.

title: Group confirm is one session-wide slot with chat_id plus an action
trigger: Open any confirm (delete chat, block, delete topic) from the main window then another from a chat window.
effect: GroupConfirmDialog{chat_id, action} uses ChatId(0) for actions with no chat (DeleteContact, BlockContact, ClearPaymentInfo) and a second opener overwrites the first.
fix: Make the action carry its own target (no ChatId(0) placeholder) and own the dialog per window.

title: New community box closes as created on dispatch
trigger: Fill the New community box and press Create; create_community returns Ok(Some) but TDLib then refuses.
effect: The dialog is taken and dropped on the send result, the note says 'Community created'; a later refusal leaves the user with no box and the typed name lost.
fix: Keep the box as Submitting{request} and close it on the answer.

title: close_info_panel does not close the pieces opened with the panel
trigger: Open a supergroup info panel (inline members, event-log search field), close it, open a user panel.
effect: Only the driver target and common_groups are reset; inline_members and admin.event_log_search keep their state and the event-log field keeps the old chat's query until the next open syncs it.
fix: Have one InfoPanelUi value that is replaced on open/close and owns these sub-states.

title: Opening an info panel with a failed fetch still leaves the target set
trigger: Open a user or group panel while the fetch request returns Err.
effect: Target is already set in the driver and the error note is shown; the panel draws empty with no retry path other than closing and reopening.
fix: Model the panel as Fetch<T> so the failure is drawn with a Retry.

title: Share link sets a session-wide share target from a chat window profile
trigger: Right-click the group link in a profile modal and choose Share.
effect: self.share.link_text is session-wide (main window state); the chooser opens in the window of the last press, not necessarily the window that asked.
fix: Use the Asker seam to name the window for the share box.

title: HdrViewer keeps its decode and window stage in key + token + slot + in_flight + polling + edr_on + edr_lost + headroom
trigger: Open an HDR picture file in the viewer, step to the next item, move the window to another screen, close the viewer.
effect: Nothing wrong today, but in_flight duplicates Slot::Decoding (a bigger re-decode keeps Slot::Hdr while in_flight is true), polling is a 'task started' flag cleared by the task itself (stays true if its update_in fails), and edr_on/edr_lost mirror window state by hand; reset() clears some and not others.
fix: One enum Decode { Idle, Decoding{key,token,showing:Option<HdrPixels>}, Sdr, StandardRange, Hdr{key,pixels} } and a separate WindowMode { Sdr, Edr, EdrLost } owned by the window; the poll task handle lives in the Hdr variant so dropping the variant stops it.

title: Headroom poll notifies every second forever once edr_lost is set on an HDR-capable screen
trigger: Open an HDR picture on a display with EDR headroom where the renderer cannot build its float pipelines (edr_lost = true), and leave the viewer open.
effect: viewer_hdr_element stores hdr.headroom = SDR.effective() = 1.0 while edr_lost, but the poll compares super::headroom(window).effective() (e.g. 2.0+) against that 1.0, sees 'changed' every tick and calls cx.notify(): a full app redraw 10 times a second for the first second and once a second after, for as long as the viewer is open.
fix: Compare against the same value the draw uses (the display headroom unless edr_lost, then SDR), computed in one function shared by draw and poll, or skip the headroom comparison when edr_lost.

title: A chat window's media viewer draws HDR frames but never switches its window to extended range
trigger: Open a chat in its own window, open an HDR picture file (gain-map JPEG / HEIC) in that window's media viewer (ViewerPart::Inline draws viewer_hdr_element via overlay.rs).
effect: sync_viewer_hdr runs only from the main window's render (app_render/mod.rs), so the chat window's layer stays 8-bit while the surface frame is tone-mapped for the display headroom: the picture is drawn dim/clipped, yet the badge says 'HDR shown' because edr_on is never true and edr_lost is therefore never detected.
fix: Run the EDR sync in the per-window upkeep (window_upkeep.rs) for whichever window's ViewerUi is in place, with the EDR mode stored per window slot.

title: edr_on is lost with the replaced OnScreen, leaving the main window's layer in extended range
trigger: Open an HDR picture in the main window's viewer, then switch accounts (OnScreen is replaced whole, including a fresh HdrViewer with edr_on = false).
effect: want (false) equals the new edr_on (false) so set_window_edr(window, false) is never called; the CAMetalLayer stays a float extended-range drawable until another HDR picture is opened and closed (extra GPU memory and a different colour pipeline for the whole window).
fix: Keep the window's EDR mode in the WindowSlot / main window state (not in the per-account viewer), or have the Farewell of the viewer force set_window_edr(false).

title: bar_focused survives a chat switch, so the new chat's unread bar reads as focused
trigger: With a screen reader on, move accessibility focus onto the 'Unread messages' bar (Up from the first unread), then open another chat that has an unread divider.
effect: MessageUi.a11y.bar_focused is per window, not per chat (ChatUi is replaced by sync_chat_ui, MessageUi.a11y is not): history_a11y_row_focus reports the new chat's bar as focused and Space/play-pause is refused (bar_focused true) before the user focused anything there.
fix: Make the a11y focus one value in ChatUi (enum A11yFocus { None, Bar, Row(MessageId) }) replacing bar_focused + selection_focus pairing, so a chat change replaces it whole.

title: HistoryA11y holds focus stage as bar_focused bool + focused bool + announce_first Option beside ChatUi::selection_focus
trigger: Screen-reader focus moves between the bar and rows, the history gains/loses keyboard focus, an empty chat receives its first messages.
effect: Three fields and a second owner (selection_focus) must change together; bar_focused true makes selection_focus meaningless, announce_first must be cleared in four places by hand (set_history_a11y_focus, focus_in, rows_changed, chat change).
fix: enum HistoryFocus { Away, Idle, ArmedForFirst(ChatId), Bar, Row(MessageId) } owned by the chat's ChatUi / the window's slot.

title: Accept / Reject on a sharing request has no in-flight stage
trigger: Click Accept (or Reject) twice quickly, or click Accept then Reject before TDLib's update removes the buttons.
effect: answer_sharing_request sends every click to the driver; the buttons stay until the message update arrives, so two answers (possibly contradictory) go out and a second error toast can appear.
fix: A per-message enum SharingAnswer { Open, Sending(approve) } in the chat's ChatUi that hides the buttons on the first click and returns to Open on error.

title: HDR JPEG XL decode holds up to three full-size float copies at once (about 2.3 GB at the 48 Mpx cap)
trigger: On Windows, open a 40+ megapixel HDR JPEG XL in the media viewer.
effect: samples (f32 x channels), the pixels Vec<[f32;4]> and then the resize buffer in scaled() are alive together; with MAX_PIXELS = 2 x HDR_MAX_PIXELS this can exhaust memory in the background job and abort the app (allocation failure is not catchable by contained()).
fix: Convert row by row from the stream into the final buffer (or downscale during conversion) and cap MAX_PIXELS at the memory the three copies need, returning Ok(None) (SDR) above it.

title: Fact-check expansion is per window, not per chat
trigger: Open a chat in the main window and in its own chat window, expand a fact check in one.
effect: fact_check_expanded lives in each window's MessageUi, so the other window shows the same fact check collapsed; the set also only grows and is not cleared on chat change.
fix: Move the set into ChatUi (per chat, replaced whole on chat change), or key it by account chat in OnScreen.

title: Probe cache Entry is a proper enum but Probing has no way out if its task is dropped
trigger: The QuillApp entity or the task is dropped between background_spawn and the result being stored (app shutdown only today).
effect: No bug today: Probing, Known and Unreadable are one enum with a retry timer. A dropped continuation would leave Probing for that path until the 1024-entry reset, so the HDR tag never appears.
fix: Store the probe task handle in the Probing variant, or store the result from the background job itself (not the foreground continuation).

title: ScrollDate keeps its stage in shown_at + last_scroll + hide_after + wake Option, with covered_row/top_label derived from probes
trigger: Scroll the history, stop, scroll again within the fade, switch chat.
effect: The stage (Hidden / Fading / Still) is recomputed from three timestamps by motion(), and wake: Option<Task> is a 'timer armed' flag that must be cleared by the task itself; covered_row is reset only when the pill is drawn.
fix: enum PillStage { Hidden, Showing{since,last_scroll,hold}, Armed{wake:Task} } replaced whole with HistoryUi on a chat change.

title: pinned_list_open is window-wide and not reset when the open chat changes
trigger: Open the pinned-messages list from the pinned bar in chat A, then click chat B (which has pinned messages) in the chat list.
effect: Chat B shows its pinned list panel open without being asked; in a chat with no pins the flag stays set and the list pops open later in the next chat with pins.
fix: Move the open flag into ChatUi (per chat) or into an enum PinnedBar { Bar, List } keyed by AccountChat so a chat change replaces it.

title: Scroller anchoring is spread over key, ends, window_epoch, anchor_pending, landing, last_highlight, highlight_fade, scroll_goal
trigger: Opening a chat, a jump, or a window replace.
effect: Each field is reset by hand in history_message_list.rs (key change resets last_highlight and scroll_date but not highlight_fade, landing, hit_rows, reported_visible).
fix: One enum Anchor { Idle, Pending{key,epoch}, Landing{..} } replaced whole on key change.

title: Row chrome refresh is a bool/Cell flag plus due list plus epoch stamps
trigger: Session change while rows are drawn.
effect: chrome_notify_pending (Cell<bool>) says a deferred notify is on its way; if the deferred task is dropped (window closed, screen replaced) the flag stays set and no further notify is queued.
fix: Replace the Cell<bool> with ChromeRefresh { Clean, Due(Vec<usize>), Notifying } owned by HistoryUi and cleared in the deferred task's drop path.

title: Tick tasks are tracked by Option<ChatId> 'Some exactly while the task runs'
trigger: Chat with self-destruct timers or a live location opens.
effect: self_destruct_tick_chat and live_location_tick_chat are cleared only from inside the task's own update closure; if the task's update fails (scope gone) the Some stays and the tick is never restarted for that chat in this HistoryUi.
fix: Hold the Task handle itself (Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)>) so dropping the owner stops the tick and the stage cannot outlive it.

title: width_probed/forum_column_shown/window_active are stage bools kept in step with paint
trigger: Resize, forum open, window focus.
effect: width_probed (Rc<Cell<bool>>) says whether the history measured itself; it is never reset when the pane changes, so seed_history_width only runs on first paint.
fix: enum HistoryWidthSource { Seeded(Pixels), Measured(Pixels) }.

title: A failed decode is cached as Loaded(Err) and never retried while the entry stays under budget
trigger: A picture whose file is partial or replaced in place at the same path fails to decode once (or a file is rewritten with new content).
effect: The tile stays blank (or shows the old decode) until the entry is evicted, which can be never when the cache is under budget.
fix: Key the entry by (path, mtime/len) and drop Err entries after a short life or on file-ready updates.

title: A sweep that finds a window mid-draw returns without rearming
trigger: A chat window is being drawn when the sweeper task runs after a retirement.
effect: Retired images wait in the atlas until some later wake (next retirement or chat frame); with nothing else drawing, they stay.
fix: On the early return, leave a pending-sweep marker that the next frame start or a short deferred wake handles.

title: Inline-mode query flow is spread over six fields in three owners
trigger: Typing @bot query in the composer.
effect: inline_results_open, inline_results_selected, inline_query_armed (Option used as 'timer armed' flag), inline_query_waiting (pending bool, taken and re-set in progress_inline_mode_here), composer_ui.inline_query_token and pending_inline_bot_alert are kept in step by hand; the session holds one inline_bot_resolve and one inline_query slot for every window.
fix: One ChatUi enum InlineMode { Off, Resolving{username}, Waiting{bot,query}, Armed{bot,query,token}, Showing{selected} } with the session slots keyed by window/chat.

title: inline_view trusts the session's single bot resolution without checking it is for this trigger's bot or window
trigger: Window A has '@botA q' in its composer, window B (or a quick edit) resolves '@botB q'.
effect: The shared inline_bot_resolve slot is replaced by the later resolve; the other window's panel shows 'Loading results...' forever (its progress sees the wrong username and drops inline_query_waiting) until the user edits its text.
fix: Key the resolve/query slots by (window, chat) (an owner key) and compare the trigger's username in inline_view.

title: send_inline_pick clears the composer before the send and does not restore it on failure
trigger: Pick an inline result while disconnected (driver.send_inline_query_result returns Err).
effect: The '@bot query' text is gone and only an error note shows; nothing was sent.
fix: Clear the composer when the send is acknowledged (a Sending stage on the pick), or restore the text on the error arm.

title: A Failed inline query for the current (chat, bot, query) is never re-asked
trigger: A first-page inline query fails (network).
effect: maybe_dispatch_inline_query returns early because the slot matches (fresh), so retyping the same query does nothing; the user must change the query text.
fix: Treat Failed as not fresh, or offer retry from the status line.

title: Closing the results panel (Esc) does not cancel an armed 100 ms query
trigger: Type '@bot q' then press Esc within 100 ms.
effect: close_inline_results clears inline_query_armed but the timer's token still matches, so the query is sent anyway (panel stays closed, wasted request).
fix: Bump the token on close.

title: begin_inline_return is set before the bot chat resolves and is never cancelled when that fails
trigger: Tap the inline results button 'Start' while the lookup fails (resolve_deep_link Err, or the username later fails to resolve), then later open the bot's chat by any route.
effect: take_inline_start finds the stale pending_start and sends '/start <parameter>' to the bot unprompted; the origin chat may also be navigated back to when a switch-inline message arrives hours later.
fix: InlineReturn becomes an enum Opening{..} -> Started{baseline}; clear it on resolve failure, chat change, account switch or a timeout of the open request.

title: flush_inline_return scans the bot chat history every frame while a return waits
trigger: A return is waiting after the start was sent and the bot never answers with a switch-inline button.
effect: Each frame walks all loaded messages; never ends (no way out).
fix: Give the Started stage an expiry and stop scanning.

title: Failed next-page inline query is re-asked on every poll batch
trigger: Scroll an inline results panel to its end; the next_offset request fails (first_page=false error leaves the slot Loaded).
effect: should_load_more is still true and nothing is in flight, so progress_inline_mode_here (every poll_live batch, including the error's) sends it again: a request loop while the panel is open.
fix: Record a failed offset on the slot (as inline_members does with failed_offset) and retry only on the next scroll.

title: press_inline_results_button closes the panel by flipping two fields
trigger: Press the bot's button.
effect: inline_results_open=false and inline_query_armed=None are written beside the same pair in send_inline_pick/close_inline_results/sync_inline_mode (four writers).
fix: A single ChatUi::close_inline() or the InlineMode enum.

title: failed_offset is set when the page is requested, so a request that fails to send blocks paging for good
trigger: Scroll the group info members list to its end while the driver call returns Err (no connection).
effect: fetch_supergroup_members_more result is ignored (let _ =) and failed_offset=Some(offset) stays; member_more_failed is never set so retry_at_scroll is not armed. next_more returns Nothing for that offset; the Retry button only shows for an empty list. Cleared only by a membership change or a different group.
fix: enum PageState { Idle, Requested{offset}, Failed{offset} } set to Failed on the Err arm too.

title: The block is reset only when the group changes, not each time the panel opens
trigger: Open the info panel of group A, scroll and fail a page, close it, reopen A.
effect: shown, failed_offset, admins_asked and the snapshot are kept from the last visit (inline_members.chat is never cleared on close), so a failed page or the administrators fallback stays latched.
fix: Reset (or drop) InlineMembersUi when the info panel target closes; key it by AccountChat.

title: Member paging stage is four fields: shown, failed_offset, retry_at_scroll, admins_asked
trigger: Scrolling the members list.
effect: Four values kept in step by hand across inline_members.rs (maybe_load_more_inline, inline_members_stale, reset).
fix: enum MemberPaging { Idle, Requested{offset}, Failed{offset,retry:bool} } plus a separate Admins{Asked} stage.

title: MembersView carries loading: bool beside failed: Option<String>
trigger: Render of the members list.
effect: Derived from SupergroupMembersFetch each frame, so both cannot be wrong at once today, but the shape is the loading+error pair the rule rejects; the snapshot RefCell is also written during render.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<MemberRow>> in the view.

title: Slot play stage is asleep + hidden_since + sound + paused + seeking + bytes
trigger: Scrolling a clip away, clicking a round video, dragging its seek ring.
effect: wants_play() combines five of them; asleep implies bytes==0 and hidden_since==None, sound implies Release is skipped; set by hand in sweep, revive, toggle_sound, seek_to, end_seek.
fix: enum SlotStage { Playing, Held{since}, Asleep, Sounding{paused}, Seeking{was_playing} }.

title: A sleeping slot whose reopen fails is retried on every history pass
trigger: A sleeping clip is painted in view but VideoPlayer::open fails (file deleted/moved).
effect: revive returns without a stage change, so each sweep opens the file again every frame the tile is visible.
fix: On open failure move the slot to a Failed stage so it shows the still.

title: A display-scale change drops every player but keeps on_demand and the sound mode of the dropped ones
trigger: Move the main window to a screen with another scale while a round video plays with sound.
effect: Players are dropped and restart muted looping; on_demand entries for them are only cleared via forget; a chat window on its own screen uses the main window's scale.
fix: Per-window scale in State.

title: GIF playback stage is playing_animation + gif + gif_started_at + gif_decodes + autoplayed_gifs + intent
trigger: Autoplay or tap a GIF.
effect: Six fields in PlaybackUi are written by hand in stop_animation_playback, play_gif_file, gif_started, gif_decoded, leave_gifs_here and stop_gif_of_window.
fix: enum GifPlayback { Idle, Waiting{intent}, Decoding{key,cancel}, Playing{key,clip,started} }.

title: autoplayed_gifs is marked before the GIF starts
trigger: A GIF autoplays but its file is outside the sandbox or waits for download (play_when_ready).
effect: The row is marked autoplayed even though nothing played, so it is never autoplayed again this visit; tapping still works.
fix: Mark in gif_started.

title: voice_tick is a bool 'task running' flag
trigger: Start a voice recording.
effect: Set before the task spawns and cleared only at the end of the task; it lives in RecordingUi (replaced on account switch) so it does not stick today.
fix: Hold Option<Task<()>> in the recording stage.

title: Storage limit sliders apply only on Release
trigger: Drag a storage slider and release outside the control or lose the pointer.
effect: If Release is not delivered the label shows the new value but the limit was never applied.
fix: Apply on blur or dialog close too.

title: Slider entities live in QuillApp.preferences, outside OnScreen
trigger: Open Data & Storage in account A, switch account.
effect: index_sliders (and AutoDelete slider) hold positions derived from account A's limits; dropped only by open_data_storage/forget_storage_sliders, not by an account swap.
fix: Move into the dialog's box state that is replaced with the account.

title: OnDemand pairs a Demand with a hand-kept `started` bool
trigger: Click a round video or GIF
effect: Stages asked -> started -> ended live in a bool plus map membership
fix: enum DemandStage { Asked, Started, Ended } held in the slot, dropped with it

title: A click demand outlives a row that never renders it and fires later
trigger: Click a downloaded round video, then switch chat before the row renders; return later
effect: The round video starts with sound from the start unprompted (forget() only runs for dropped slots, frame_start leaves do not clear on_demand)
fix: Expire the demand when its window's history pass ends (frame_start/leave) or tie it to the visit it was asked in

title: start_demand consumed in render even when toggle_sound returns false, so the click is lost
trigger: Click a round video the moment its player opens, before it can toggle sound
effect: Next frame start_demand is false and the player is muted so end_demand drops the demand: nothing plays with sound, no feedback
fix: Make the demand a stage the player advances (Asked -> Playing) and only leave Asked when sound actually started; do not mutate it from render

title: InlineReturn is a state machine in Option<String> pending_start plus baseline
trigger: Press an inline results switch-to-PM button
effect: Stages WaitingToOpen / StartSent{baseline} / Returned are pending_start.is_some() and baseline!=0 by hand
fix: enum InlineReturnStage { AwaitStart{param}, StartSent{baseline} }

title: baseline is 0 when the bot chat history is not loaded at start time
trigger: Press the switch-PM button for a bot whose chat was never opened; the start goes out before history loads
effect: When history loads, an old bot message with a switch-inline button has id > 0 and sends the user back to the origin chat immediately
fix: Take the baseline from the sent start message id (the send ack), not the loaded history

title: InlineReturn never expires if the round trip is abandoned
trigger: Press switch-PM, close the bot chat or never open it, later open that bot chat by hand
effect: pending_start still Some so the start is sent unprompted; or after the start any later bot message with a switch button jumps the user back to the old origin chat
fix: Clear it on chat change away from the bot chat, on cancel and after a timeout/visit change

title: fire_resize takes the resize callback out while it runs so a nested set_zoom skips relayout
trigger: Change the interface scale twice while GPUI is inside the resize callback (e.g. from a deferred settings update)
effect: The inner relayout is silently skipped; window keeps the old scale until next real resize
fix: Queue a pending zoom re-fire (enum Idle/Running/RunAgain) instead of skipping

title: details_link is set before the members request and the Err of open_chat_invite_link_members is ignored
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite links, tap a link's details while offline/driver refuses
effect: Block shows Loading... forever (no members page, no error); also two stores (dialog.details_link and session invite_pages.members) kept in step by hand
fix: Make details one enum owned by the page (Closed/Loading/Loaded/Failed) set from the driver result

title: revoked_open toggled before fetch; fetch Err ignored
trigger: Toggle Revoked links while the driver refuses the fetch
effect: Shows loading row forever (fetch map has no entry)
fix: Open state and Fetch<T> as one enum

title: InviteLinkMembersState keeps loading bool beside error and request
trigger: Open who joined through a link
effect: loading/error/request can disagree (state/info_types.rs:356)
fix: Fetch<T>-style enum Loading{request}/Loaded/Failed

title: Delete-all-revoked alert is not owned by the account/box and acts on a bare chat_id
trigger: Open Delete all alert, switch account (or close the settings box) then press Delete
effect: delete_all_revoked_chat_invite_links(chat_id) runs against the new account's driver; alert returns true (closes) regardless of result
fix: Open the confirmation through the Asker seam owned by (account, chat); drop it in Farewell

title: Delete-revoked-by-admin alert acts on a bare chat_id and relies on whichever admin page is still open
trigger: Open the alert on another admin's links page, switch account or go back, press Delete
effect: Deletes revoked links on the wrong account/admin, or errors silently
fix: Owned confirmation keyed by OfAccount+admin page; closed by Farewell

title: toggle_link_requests ignores the Err of open_link_join_requests
trigger: Tap Requests on a link while the driver refuses
effect: Nothing opens and no note
fix: Set an error note on Err

title: InviteLinkBox holds `custom` Option and focus_custom bool that must move together
trigger: Open Custom limit/date
effect: focus_custom survives a set_invite_link_custom(None) and is consumed from a dialog build
fix: Put focus request inside CustomBox::Limit{input, focus_pending}

title: Box closes as saved once the request is queued; a later TDLib error loses the typed form
trigger: Create a link that the server rejects (limit, rights)
effect: Box is already gone, error only as a status note; name, dates and fee must be retyped
fix: Keep the box in a Saving stage until the answer, reopen on error

title: focus_custom is taken during dialog build, not when the field is drawn
trigger: Open Custom limit; build runs but content closure never runs before a rebuild
effect: Number field is not focused
fix: Focus on first paint of the field entity

title: Checkout is form_loading + form_paid + form + note + validated + shipping_id + verification_started + dialog Option
trigger: Press Buy / open any invoice
effect: payment_dialog_visible derives stage from 3 fields by hand
fix: enum Checkout { Idle, LoadingForm{request}, Form, Paying, Paid, Failed{note} }

title: submit_stars_payment has no in-flight guard; only the render disables the button
trigger: Double-click Pay on a Stars/gift/giveaway form faster than a frame
effect: Two sendPaymentForm for a non-message invoice (payment_extra does not dedupe); Stars may be charged twice if the server accepts both
fix: Check checkout_sending()/Paying stage in submit_stars_payment itself

title: HistoryCalendar has loading bool with exhausted bool and generation
trigger: Open Jump to date, change month
effect: loading/exhausted/oldest_loaded are kept in step by hand (state/history_calendar.rs:54)
fix: enum Pages { Loading{gen}, More, Exhausted }

title: Shortcut capture is capture Option + error Option + applied bool reset by two free functions
trigger: Rebind a shortcut then leave the page or switch account
effect: capture/error/applied must be cleared in step (capture_active, invalidate_account_keybindings)
fix: enum Capture { Idle, Armed{id}, Rejected{id,msg} } plus keymap generation

title: Choosing a language rewrites the recent-languages file with packs the user just removed
trigger: Settings > Language: open the ... menu of a recent (non-official) pack and choose Delete (it dims, file written without it); then pick any other language row without leaving the page.
effect: install_language saves self.language.recent (which still holds the removed pack, filtered only in leave_language_settings), so the removed pack is written back and reappears in the list next visit.
fix: Apply a removal to LanguageUi::recent at once and keep only a 'dimmed for Restore' view in the box (Recent entry enum Kept/Removed), so every save writes one list.

title: Language page opened before an account switch never asks the new account for the pack list
trigger: With the Settings window on Language, switch account from the main window: language.open is still Some (LanguageUi is app-level, not OnScreen), so ensure_language_box returns early and request_language_packs is not sent to the new session.
effect: The page shows 'No languages found' (packs empty, packs_loading false) until the user leaves and re-enters the page.
fix: Make the request part of a Fetch<Vec<LanguagePackInfo>> in the session that the page asks for whenever it is Idle, instead of a once-per-visit Option in app state.

title: Failed language list request shows 'No languages found' with no retry
trigger: Settings > Language while TDLib getLocalizationTargetInfo errors or the request send fails.
effect: packs_loading is cleared on error and packs stays empty, so the page claims no languages exist instead of an error; no retry until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<LanguagePackInfoData>> with a Failed variant that the page renders with a Retry.

title: Language switch flow is ready/patch/reload/error/switching/current taken field by field
trigger: drain_language takes ready, patch, reload and error from session.settings.language every frame; switching and current decide if a reload or an in-flight pick is ignored.
effect: Several fields move together by hand; no bug found today.
fix: One enum LanguageFlow { Idle, Fetching(list), Switching{info}, Installed, Failed(err) } with a queue of patches.

title: Gift code lookup is loading/applying/applied/error/info kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a giftcode link, press Use Link; GiftCodeLookup carries loading, applying, applied, error and info together; gift_code_body draws 'applied' and an error together and can_apply recomputes the stage from three of them.
effect: Applied and error can both be set so the box shows 'Premium is now active' and a red error together; the stage is re-derived in the view.
fix: enum GiftCodeStage { Checking, Known(info), Applying(info), Applied(info), Failed(err) }.

title: Language link lookup is loading plus info plus error
trigger: Open a setlanguage link; LanguageLinkLookup has loading, info and error read separately by language_body.
effect: Loading and error can be set together; no bug found today.
fix: Use Fetch<LanguagePackInfo>.

title: Main window close state is closed_by_user plus hide_after_full_screen plus a polling task
trigger: Close the main window in full screen on a Mac: hide_after_full_screen is set, a 3 s poll waits; raising the window or Cmd-Tab clears one flag but not the other; closed_by_user is never cleared.
effect: Two bools in a Global describe one of: Open, ClosedHidden, LeavingFullScreenThenHide; closed_by_user stays true forever after the first close.
fix: enum MainWindowState { Shown, LeavingFullScreen(task), Hidden } on the Global.

title: closed_by_user is never reset, so activation logic trusts hidden() alone after the first close
trigger: Close the main window once (hide), reopen from the tray, later minimize it and Cmd-Tab (on a Mac where is_hidden_on_mac also reports a minimized window).
effect: main_window_on_activation sees closed_by_user true and raises the window the user only minimized, or does so when a chat window is the last active.
fix: Clear the flag in raise_main_window by making it part of the MainWindowState enum.

title: Deep link flow origin is spread over flow_window, pending_flow_window, pending_deep_link_ui, pending_deep_link_open and deep_link_invite
trigger: Click a t.me link in a chat window; the window travels in flow_window while the flow runs, then moves to pending_flow_window when the resolved link waits for render; each is taken by hand at each step.
effect: Origin fields must be moved/cleared in step with the payload; a missed take leaks the window to the next link.
fix: enum LinkFlow { Idle, Resolving{from}, Waiting{from, ui|open}, Asking{from, invite} } so the window cannot outlive its stage.

title: Live location tick uses Option<ChatId> as a 'task started' flag
trigger: history.live_location_tick_chat is set before the task is spawned and cleared by the task's last update; a task dropped by a screen change never clears it (it lives in HistoryUi, which is replaced with the screen, so fine today).
effect: A started-flag kept next to a detached task; no bug found today.
fix: Hold the Task in HistoryUi (Option<(ChatId, Task)>) so dropping the owner stops it and clears the flag.

title: Live location 'expires in' line is refreshed only for the main window's open chat
trigger: Open a chat with a running live location in its own chat window while another chat is open in the main window.
effect: ensure_live_location_tick is keyed on session.open_chat and only notifies when the main window is active, so the chat window's countdown does not tick.
fix: Run the tick per window slot (WindowSlot) keyed by the chat shown there.

title: Locate times out after 30 s while the macOS permission prompt may still be open
trigger: On macOS first use, open Send Location and leave the system 'Allow location' prompt unanswered for over 30 s, then allow.
effect: poll_answer returns None after LOCATE_TIMEOUT and the picker records Unavailable; the later fix goes to a dropped receiver, so the picker stays 'unavailable' until My Location is pressed.
fix: Let the platform lookup report a Waiting-for-permission state and time out only after the permission is decided; cancel the manager when the receiver is dropped.

title: CLLocationManager keeps running after the picker closes
trigger: Open Send Location with permission pending or a slow fix, then close the picker.
effect: The task and receiver are dropped but RUNNING keeps the manager and delegate alive and updating until the next lookup or an answer; nothing stops it on close.
fix: Give locate() a cancel handle that stops and drops the manager when the receiver is dropped.

title: A mouse-up lost outside the window leaves drag set and the map stuck moving
trigger: Press on the map, drag out of the window, release with the app deactivated.
effect: location_ui.drag stays Some, location_map_settled returns early on drag.is_some(), so the pin stays lifted, move_ended never runs, no venues or address refresh until the next click.
fix: Clear drag on window deactivation or on any mouse-move without the button pressed.

title: Location picker UI keeps search, drag, settle, resolve, search_timer, locate and geocode as separate Options beside the session picker
trigger: The picker's search_shown, moving and address stages live in Session::location while location_ui.search/drag and five tasks mirror them and are reset together by reset().
effect: Task Options are stage flags (settle/resolve/search_timer set means 'waiting'); the search field Option must agree with picker.search_shown.
fix: One enum PickerPhase { Idle, Moving{drag}, Settling(task), ResolvingAddress(task) } plus Search { Closed, Open(input, debounce) } and Locate { Idle, Locating(task) }.

title: Marketplace box is marketplace_open/chat/error/private beside the session gift's loading/sending/completed
trigger: Open Buy collectible by name, load a gift, pick a price, buy: stage is spread over PaymentUi fields and MarketplaceGift loading, sending, completed, note, price.
effect: Error lives in two places (marketplace_error and gift.note); busy is re-derived as loading||sending in two places.
fix: enum MarketplaceStage { Entering, Loading, Quoted(q), Buying(q), Bought, Failed(e) } owned by the session, with the box open flag derived.

title: Opening the marketplace from another chat while a purchase is loading keeps the first chat
trigger: Start loading a gift from chat A's Send Gift box, close the box, open Buy by name from chat B before it finishes.
effect: busy skips the reset, so marketplace_chat stays A and the gift buys for A; B's request is silently dropped (recipient name shown is A's).
fix: Key the gift by ChatId and compare it with the asking chat before reusing it.

title: Chosen sticker category is a bare index into the session's category list
trigger: Choose a category in the sticker tab; later the list is reloaded (sticker_categories_asked reset, premium state change) in another order.
effect: pickers.media_panel.category is an index, so after a reload it can name another category; wanted_sticker_search then searches that one.
fix: Store the EmojiCategorySource (the key) instead of the index.

title: Main menu open flag, filter text and highlight index are kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the menu, type to filter, arrow down; closing resets highlight but not the filter, opening clears the filter and highlight in set_main_menu_open.
effect: highlight is an index into a filtered list recomputed each frame; archive appearing or disappearing shifts the tile under the highlight.
fix: enum MainMenu { Closed, Open{filter, highlight: Option<Entry>} } keyed by Entry, not index.

title: LayerDraw ticked bool and redrawn Option<Instant> describe one of three stages
trigger: The frame clock ticks a layer, then it draws once for the tick, then redraws on a vsync.
effect: ticked and redrawn are kept in step by ticked()/drawn(); no bug found today.
fix: enum LayerStage { Idle, Ticked, Redrawn(Instant) }.
